bounds: The driver accepts only the four reviewed IDs and their exact finite input tuples in cases.jsonl.
call_sequence: Set Surface fire inputs for MIDSLOPE_WINDWARD with zero ridge distance and elevation and CLOSED canopy.

scope: Measure flat terrain Surface fire at the public input values. F-018 records the upstream wind conversion. The measurement excludes mountainous outputs, torching trees, piles, and active Crown fire.
